# Gaurav Nagarkoti

> Independent software architect based in India. Remote work with US, UK, and European operators. Custom software, commerce platforms, internal HR/CRM systems, WhatsApp/n8n automation, and AI learning products. English. USD. Systems the client team owns.

Not an agency. Not staff augmentation. Not managed IT. Primary contact: gauravnagarkoti08@gmail.com. Site: https://gauravnagarkoti.tech

## Services

- [Custom software development](https://gauravnagarkoti.tech/solutions/custom-software-development): Owned business software — not vendor lock-in
- [Web application development](https://gauravnagarkoti.tech/solutions/web-application-development): Operator dashboards and product platforms
- [Business automation](https://gauravnagarkoti.tech/solutions/business-automation): Workflows that replace manual ops
- [ERP and Odoo integration](https://gauravnagarkoti.tech/solutions/erp-odoo-integration): Data contracts between ERP, commerce, and CRM
- [Ecommerce and payments](https://gauravnagarkoti.tech/solutions/ecommerce-payments): Checkout, gateways, and order flows under load
- [Software architecture](https://gauravnagarkoti.tech/solutions/software-architecture): Reviews and blueprints the team can implement
